dependencies.title: Extreme gaps between eigenvalues of random matrices

dependencies.mapping: For Haar CUE(N), consecutive circular eigenangle gaps scaled by N^(4/3), with angular location in an interior arc, converge to a marked Poisson process. Seam and all-pair singular-tail reductions are proved separately in the project; no theorem about the fixed deterministic map is supplied by this source.

dependencies.title: Characteristic Lyapunov exponents and smooth ergodic theory
dependencies.mapping: Smooth normalized area invariant under analytic G_kappa has entropy equal to its positive Lyapunov exponent, the integral of log unstable expansion; together with the Ruelle inequality this identifies P(-phi)=0.

dependencies.title: An inequality for the entropy of differentiable maps
dependencies.identifier: Boletim da Sociedade Brasileira de Matematica 9 (1978), 83-87; https://www.ihes.fr/~ruelle/PUBLICATIONS/%5B51%5D.pdf
dependencies.mapping: For every invariant probability on the smooth area-preserving Anosov two-torus, entropy is at most the integral of the one-dimensional unstable potential; hence P(-phi)<=0. Entropy upper bound for every invariant measure of the actual smooth area-preserving Anosov map; combined with verified Mane1981+1983errata and Gibbs uniqueness to identify pressure-zero area, not a quantum trace theorem.

dependencies.title: A simple and self-contained proof for the Lindemann-Weierstrass theorem
dependencies.locator: Theorem 3.2 (the linear independence of exponentials of distinct algebraic exponents over all algebraic coefficients); Corollary 3.2, printed p.16 (nonzero complex algebraic exponent has transcendental exponential)
dependencies.mapping: For nonzero real algebraic time t, collected finite exponential polynomials with real algebraic frequencies vanish at t exactly when identically zero; used with a separate imaginary-time nonvanishing witness for discriminants, resultants and fixed-model traces. The theorem gives no quantitative lower bound. The algebraic-entry antiunitary corollary uses the same input. TRACE-013 uses only Corollary 3.2 and nonzero algebraic-coefficient polynomials at one transcendental exponential for its factorial flat perturbation. FLOW-013 uses Corollary 3.2 for one eigenvalue rotation, ensuring all positive power traces of its abstract clustered starting family are nonzero without quantitative cancellation. FM-024 uses Theorem 3.2 only for its algebraic-entry literal-propagator corollary: spectral projectors of the Hermitian algebraic generator have algebraic entries even with repeated eigenvalues; entrywise separation of the distinct algebraic exponents forces commutation with both A and M. The common-commutant theorem itself is independent of this external input. Additional scoped use: four finite N=21,35,49,63 U-simplicity cases via prior imaginary-time leading-minor discriminant; one-step squared-trace transcendence for all odd N except7 by collected algebraic difference frequencies and unique extreme coefficient, including repeated eigenvalues. No higher-power seven-divisible conclusion.
